m: a positive integer equal to the number of grid rows
n: a positive integer equal to the number of grid columns
i: an integer row index used in the problem statement
j: an integer column index used in the problem statement
r: an integer row coordinate of a path vertex
s: a nonnegative integer counting leftward steps in the auxiliary word argument
w: a target word in the letters D and L
I(w): The number of pairs of positions in w in which an S is earlier than an E.
inversion number: the number of ordered pairs of path-word positions in which an S occurs before an E
c: an integer column coordinate of a path vertex
a: a nonnegative integer denoting a number of D letters in the word induction
b: a nonnegative integer denoting a number of L letters in the word induction
D_k: the northwest-southeast diagonal consisting of grid squares (i,j) with i-j=k
v_k: the unique vacant square on D_k in a reachable configuration
R: a transition between successive diagonal vacancies that increases the first coordinate by 1
B: a transition between successive diagonal vacancies that decreases the second coordinate by 1
